programs: NBN Fixed Wireless and Satellite Upgrade Program

The Regional Connectivity Program (RCP) is a competitive grant opportunity to expand the economic, social and public safety benefits of improved digital connectivity to regional, rural and remote Australian communities.

The Grantee will upgrade the NBN service technologies in the towns of Cunnamulla, Quilpie, Mullewa, Ravensthorpe, Boulia, Julia Creek, Sea Lake, Fitzroy Crossing, Onslow, Lameroo and Pinnaroo to improve connectivity and support local communities.
The Grantee will deliver a range of Area Switch projects to change the existing local telecommunications infrastructure throughout Australia.
Funding to provide free community Wi-Fi to around 20 remote communities using NBN Co's satellite technology

The project is the West Coast Tasmania NBN Area Switch, which will upgrade local telecommunications infrastructure to provide broadband technology, fixed line services to Queenstown, Zeehan and Rosebery and fixed wireless services in Strahan.

The grant will extend the service period of existing Sky Muster Plus satellite community Wi-Fi services under the STAND program to 31 December 2027, and expand the program footprint by up to 500 new sites with the same operation period.

grants.n: The funds will be used to upgrade the NBN fixed wireless network and improve services on NBN Co's satellite network.
